name: Golden September
story: A perfect, windless day with the low autumn sun lighting everything gold: the birches turning on the hills, the water still, the air clear. At night, a deep starry sky and a glow of aurora in the north.
forecast: Clear. Calm, west 4 kt in the afternoon. Visibility 70 km. Clear, cold night, aurora possible. A FRONT is forecast for the day after tomorrow.
